title: A Wrinkle in Time
author: Madeleine L'Engle
summary: Meg Murry, her gifted little brother and a friend travel through space and time with three strange guides to rescue her missing father, and have to face a spreading darkness on a planet.
readIf: you want a short, imaginative classic mixing science, fantasy and a reluctant hero.
skipIf: you want deep science; it is more fantasy and moral allegory than science fiction.

pairings.reason: Another children's classic with a Christian-tinged battle between light and dark.
A richer and more daring young-reader fantasy with parallel worlds.
A lighter, funnier magical adventure with a clever girl at the centre.
